---
title: "Indicator-taxa"
output: html_document
date: "2026-02-25"
---

```{r Vitamin C}
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggpubr)
library(microbiome)
library(indicspecies)

set.seed(421)
ps = readRDS('phyloseq.rds')

ps_genus = tax_glom(ps, taxrank = "Genus")

indval_vit_C = multipatt( t(ps_genus@otu_table), 
                    cluster = ps_filt@sam_data$Vitamin_C,
                    control = how(nperm = 999) )

summary(indval_vit_C, indvalcomp = TRUE)

# Extract into table
indval_vit_C_table = as.data.frame(indval_vit_C$sign) %>%
  filter(stat >=0.5, p.value <= 0.05)

indval_vit_C_table 

df <- data.frame(Genus = c("Escherichia-Shigella", "Victivallis", "Muribaculaceae"),
                 Specificity = c(0.9229, 0.8818, 0.9181),
                 Fidelity = c(0.5528, 0.3659, 0.3577),
                 'Stat' = c(0.714, 0.568, 0.573),
                 'P-value' = c(0.048, 0.008, 0.005),
                 "Associated Intake Level(s)" = c("Low & Typical", "High & Typical","High & Typical"),
                 check.names = FALSE)

# Table with blank theme
tab <- ggtexttable(df, rows = NULL, theme = ttheme("blank")) %>%
 tab_add_hline(at.row = 1:2, row.side = "top", linewidth = 3.5) %>%
  tab_add_hline(at.row = 4, row.side = "bottom", linewidth = 3.5) %>%
  tab_add_title(text = "Table 1. Indicator species analysis associated with vitamin C intake levels",
                face = "bold")
tab

```
